rejected_commits.reason: Linked, but it is the 'Release v3.7' version bump: it changes only HISTORY.rst, LICENSE.md and __version__ in idna/package_data.py. No fix in it.

truth_evidence: Affected every release before 3.7; fixed in 3.7 (crafted input makes idna.encode take quadratic time in the CONTEXTJ check).

Fix commit 5beb28b 'More efficient resolution of joiner contexts' (PR #172), in tag v3.7 and not in v3.6. HISTORY for 3.7: 'Fix issue where specially crafted inputs to encode() would take exceptionally long amount of time to process. [CVE-2024-3651]'. https://github.com/kjd/idna/commit/5beb28b9dd77912c0dd656d8b0fdba3eb80222e7
valid_contextj: the backwards and forwards scans for joining types now stop at the first non-transparent code point ('else: break') instead of scanning the whole label.
check_label: the try/except ValueError around valid_contextj is removed (the same hunk).
The commit also regenerates idna/idnadata.py (data, not code) and tools/idna-data (outside the package).

Entry points: encode -> alabel -> check_label -> valid_contextj; decode -> ulabel -> check_label; the idna.codec classes call alabel/ulabel. All of idna.core's public functions are re-exported as idna.X.
notes: 068f48f 'Remove redundant steps' (alabel) is also between v3.6 and v3.7 and touches idna/core.py; it is an unrelated refactor, not part of the fix. Relevant for phase B's commit ranking.
